# FiberTools, Free Calculators for Knitters, Crocheters & Weavers
> https://fibertools.app

FiberTools is a suite of 34 free, browser-based calculators and references for fiber arts, knitting, crochet, weaving, spinning, embroidery, cross stitch, and sewing. Each tool states the inputs, arithmetic model, and limitations that apply to its result.

Core calculator arithmetic runs in the browser. Optional network features, including pattern recommendations, newsletter signup, and paid services, use separately disclosed workflows and may send the filters or details needed for that feature. No login is required for self-service calculators, and many core tools work offline. All self-service calculators stay free. Optional professional reviews and project downloads are paid.

## Tools

### Knitting & Crochet
- [Yarn Calculator](https://fibertools.app/yarn-calculator): Scale yarn measured in a representative flat swatch to a rectangular target, add an explicit planning allowance, and convert the result to whole skeins.
- [Needle & Hook Size Converter](https://fibertools.app/needle-converter): Convert knitting needle and crochet hook sizes between US, UK, metric, and Japanese systems.
- [Gauge Calculator](https://fibertools.app/gauge-calculator): Calculate gauge from a swatch and perform bounded stitch- and row-count arithmetic when all required values are supplied.
- [Yarn Weight Chart](https://fibertools.app/yarn-weight-chart): Interactive yarn weight chart with US, UK, and Australian names plus substitution compatibility checker.
- [Stitch Counter](https://fibertools.app/stitch-counter): Track up to six named counts and set exact-count reminders on the first counter. Browser-local saving is attempted but not guaranteed.
- [Blanket Calculator](https://fibertools.app/blanket-calculator): Calculate blanket stitch and row counts, then scale yarn measured in a representative swatch to the entered target dimensions.
- [Increase & Decrease Calculator](https://fibertools.app/increase-decrease-calculator): Build a bounded one-row or one-round plan for distributing an entered increase or decrease.
- [Stripe Generator](https://fibertools.app/stripe-generator): Generate a bounded random, weighted, or repeating stripe-row sequence from entered colors and row limits.
- [Abbreviation Glossary](https://fibertools.app/abbreviation-glossary): Searchable glossary of knitting and crochet abbreviations with US/UK toggle.
- [Stitch Pattern Calculator](https://fibertools.app/stitch-pattern-calculator): Find bounded whole totals satisfying entered multiple-plus constraints; arithmetic compatibility does not validate a pattern or construction.
- [Stitch Quick Reference](https://fibertools.app/stitch-quick-reference): Visual steps for the crochet and knitting stitches included in the reference.
- [UK to US Converter](https://fibertools.app/uk-to-us-converter): Replace supported modern UK and US crochet terms in pasted text using a one-pass mapping; other text is unchanged.
- [Crochet Circle Round Planner](https://fibertools.app/circle-calculator): Generate a basic staggered-increase schedule from an entered starting count and round limit; swatch and adjust for the material and stitch.
- [Sewing & Craft Needle Guide](https://fibertools.app/needle-guide): Compare the needle types and use cases included in the visual reference.
- [Amigurumi Shapes Guide](https://fibertools.app/amigurumi-shapes): Generate bounded arithmetic schedules for included sphere, cone, cylinder, and oval starting shapes; verify technique and counts before use.
- [Project Cost Calculator](https://fibertools.app/project-cost-calculator): Total the yarn, notions, and extras entered, with an optional stitch-rate time estimate and selling-price scenario.
- [Color Pooling Calculator](https://fibertools.app/color-pooling-calculator): Preview how an entered repeating color-run sequence maps across a chosen stitch count; swatching is required.
- [WPI to Yarn Weight Converter](https://fibertools.app/wpi-calculator): Enter wraps per inch to identify yarn weight, recommended needles, hooks, gauge range, and project ideas.
- [Cast On Calculator](https://fibertools.app/cast-on-calculator): Calculate a rounded cast-on count from entered width and gauge, with optional pattern-multiple and edge-stitch adjustments.
- [Hat Size Calculator](https://fibertools.app/hat-calculator): Calculate a rounded cast-on count and bounded eight-section crown schedule from entered head measurement, ease, and gauge.
- [Sock Circumference Stitch Calculator](https://fibertools.app/sock-calculator): Calculate one bounded circular stitch-count checkpoint from entered circumference, ease, measured gauge, and stitch multiple; no heel, toe, or length is inferred.
- [Sleeve Shaping Calculator](https://fibertools.app/sleeve-calculator): Plan a bounded paired-decrease sleeve taper; odd stitch gaps and schedules denser than one event per shaping row are declined.
- [Raglan Body Stitch Checkpoint](https://fibertools.app/raglan-calculator): Calculate one bounded finished-body stitch checkpoint from entered circumference, measured gauge, and stitch multiple; no neckline, yoke, split, or fit is inferred.
- [Blocking Dimension Change Calculator](https://fibertools.app/blocking-calculator): Calculate the signed percentage change between current and requested width or length; method selection remains care-instruction and swatch led.
- [Yarn Stash Estimator](https://fibertools.app/stash-estimator): Estimate remaining yardage in partial skeins by weight, plus a yardage reference table for unlabeled yarn.

### Crochet
- [C2C Blanket Calculator](https://fibertools.app/c2c-calculator): Round entered dimensions to a bounded nominal C2C grid from a two-axis swatch, with optional measured yarn-per-block planning arithmetic.
- [Granny Square Planner](https://fibertools.app/granny-square-planner): Plan a nominal grid, square count, equal-share color average, and unique internal seam length from entered dimensions.

### Spinning
- [Spinning Wheel Drive Ratio Calculator](https://fibertools.app/spinning-ratio-calculator): Calculate the ideal geometric ratio between a drive wheel and its connected pulley without inferring finished yarn.

### Weaving
- [Weaving Sett Calculator](https://fibertools.app/weaving-sett-calculator): Compare a yarn/structure lookup with project dimensions, warp allowances, and a supplied reed; verify the plan with a sample.

### Cross Stitch
- [Cross Stitch Calculator](https://fibertools.app/cross-stitch-calculator): Calculate dimensions for an entered stitch count and supported fabric count, with a planning estimate for stranded-cotton use.

### Embroidery
- [Thread Converter](https://fibertools.app/thread-converter): Look up exact entries in the included DMC, Anchor, and Cosmo embroidery-thread table.

## Guides

- [How to Read a Yarn Label](https://fibertools.app/guides/reading-yarn-labels): Complete guide to yarn weight symbols, care instructions, dye lots, and gauge information on yarn labels.
- [Knitting Gauge: Why It Matters](https://fibertools.app/guides/knitting-gauge-guide): How to make a gauge swatch, block it, measure it, and resize patterns when your gauge doesn't match.
- [How Much Yarn for a Blanket?](https://fibertools.app/guides/blanket-yarn-guide): Yardage estimates by blanket size and yarn weight, from baby blankets to king-size bedspreads.
- [Knitting Needle Sizes Explained](https://fibertools.app/guides/needle-sizes-guide): US, UK, and metric needle sizing systems explained, plus how to identify unlabeled needles.
- [UK vs US Crochet Terms](https://fibertools.app/guides/uk-us-crochet-terms-guide): Complete conversion guide between UK and US crochet terminology with full chart.
- [What is WPI and How to Measure It](https://fibertools.app/guides/wpi-guide): How wraps per inch works, how to measure it, and WPI ranges for every yarn weight category.
- [How to Price Handmade Knitting and Crochet](https://fibertools.app/guides/pricing-handmade-guide): Calculate the real cost of handmade items including materials, time, and pricing for commissions.
- [Beginner's Guide to Amigurumi](https://fibertools.app/guides/amigurumi-beginners-guide): Shapes, sizes, and math for crochet amigurumi including magic ring, increases, and connecting parts.
- [How to Crochet a Flat Circle](https://fibertools.app/guides/flat-circle-crochet-guide): Why you increase by 6 every round, how to fix cupping and ruffling, and round-by-round stitch counts.
- [Sewing & Craft Needle Types](https://fibertools.app/guides/sewing-craft-needle-guide): Tapestry, chenille, sharps, betweens, and other needle types explained with use cases.
- [Hat Sizing Guide](https://fibertools.app/guides/knit-crochet-hat-sizing-guide): Head circumference charts, negative ease, crown shaping methods, and brim options.
- [Knitting Socks: Sizing & Construction](https://fibertools.app/guides/knitting-socks-sizing-guide): Sock anatomy, heel construction options, top-down vs toe-up, and yarn recommendations.
- [Sleeve Shaping Guide](https://fibertools.app/guides/knitting-sleeve-shaping-guide): How to calculate tapers, sleeve lengths by size, and sleeve cap shaping for set-in sleeves.
- [Top-Down Raglan Sweaters](https://fibertools.app/guides/raglan-sweater-guide): Raglan increase math, neckline options, stitch distribution, and sizing from measurements.
- [How to Plan Blocking](https://fibertools.app/guides/blocking-fiber-guide): Use product care instructions, representative swatch tests, and measured dimension changes to plan finishing.
- [Yarn Stash Management](https://fibertools.app/guides/yarn-stash-management-guide): Estimating yardage from partial skeins, organizing your stash, and scrap yarn project ideas.
- [Corner-to-Corner Crochet (C2C)](https://fibertools.app/guides/c2c-crochet-guide): How C2C construction works, increase and decrease rows, and sizing for graphghans.
- [Granny Square Blankets](https://fibertools.app/guides/granny-square-blanket-guide): Layout planning, square counts, joining methods, and border finishing.
- [Knitting Cast-On Methods](https://fibertools.app/guides/cast-on-methods-guide): Long-tail, cable, tubular, and more, stretch levels, difficulty, and best use cases.
- [Crochet Stitch Reference](https://fibertools.app/guides/crochet-stitch-reference-guide): Basic stitches, stitch height, reading diagrams, and common stitch combinations.
- [Yarn Stripe Patterns](https://fibertools.app/guides/yarn-stripe-patterns-guide): Color planning, carrying yarn vs cutting, weaving in ends, and yardage calculation.
